headline: Dawn's blown, then it cleans into a fun fish session.
today: Dawn is onshore and messy at 13mph, so don't bother early. Give it until mid-morning when the W cross fills in and the short-period SSE goes rideable at chest-high-plus — fish it around the midday high. It stays soft and short-period all day, but the wind cooperates from late morning on.

daysToWatch.note: NNW offshore prime-angle dawn — small but glassy, worth a quick log.
Prime SE angle, light SE at dawn — cleanest local window of the weekend.
